This can be particularly relevant in the context of fully remote work, where employees may be more focused and productive at home, but also more susceptible to distractions. Presenteeism is often contrasted with absenteeism, which refers to the absence of employees from work due to illness or other reasons. By understanding presenteeism, researchers and managers can better evaluate the trade-offs between remote work and traditional office arrangements.
